bg_1.notes: 3-storey apricot corner block with a streamline corner, wrap-around ribbons and a fin trio.

bg_2.notes: 2-storey powder-blue MiMo motel/office: cantilevered walkway on V columns, floating roof, sign blade.

bg_3.notes: 4-storey mint Deco with a glass-block spine between fins, ziggurat crown, finial and portholes.

bg_4.notes: 3-storey butter-yellow streamline apartments: stacked round-ended balconies, stair drum with portholes.

plot_beach_bar.notes: Hangout beach bar on the sand: timber deck on short posts (top 0.35 m above the origin, posts to -0.5 m), striped hip canopy over a bow-front bar with six stools, back bar with bottles, loungers under an umbrella, day bed, festoon lights on timber poles and a marquee sign on the ridge.

plot_beach_cafe.notes: Single-storey streamline beach cafe: rounded pavilion with a wrap-around ribbon window, floating roof slab, rooftop sign blade, deep coral striped awning over a serving counter, timber deck with four working tables in the open, festoon lights and palms at the front corners.

plot_coworking.notes: Co-working overflow: two-storey MiMo office, storefront glazing wrapping a rounded corner, thick white floor band, breeze-block screen, floating roof slab, sign pylon facing local -X (the camera once the client turns it 90 deg); long shared work table under festoon lights.

plot_deco_hotel.notes: Hero plot: 3-storey Deco hotel turned studio, centre bay with glass-block spine, fins and a stepped crown; terrace with two desks, bar with two working stools, lounger, a seating stoop, palms in the front planters and festoon lights from the eyebrows to the front wall.

plot_diner.notes: MiMo diner: long glazed front with cherry booths inside, chrome bands, an upswept roof that cantilevers into a prow over the entrance, walk-up counter, starburst sign pylon, festoon lights from the roof fascia over the patio.

plot_juice_kiosk.notes: Juice kiosk: a round kiosk with a flying-saucer roof, neon rim and a lit orange ball on a mast, a stool ledge around its window; a big pergola terrace (rafters run front to back so the camera sees the tables between them) with festoons along the rafters.

plot_marina_office.notes: Marina / boat-hire office: ship-like streamline base with a rounded bow, railed roof deck and a wraparound bridge, a lookout tower with portholes and a lantern room, mast with bulb dressing lines; hire counter with stools under a shallow awning, a dinghy on cradles, dock tables and bollards.

plot_motel_court.notes: Motel court: two-storey L of rooms with a lamp by every door, an open upper walkway with pipe rails and an outside stair, office with an eyebrow, a raised pool whose coping is a seat, loungers, poolside tables and a googie sign with a bulb-lit arrow.

plot_record_shop.notes: Record shop / gallery walk-up: three storeys with a curved shop window, glass-block transom, eyebrows, round-ended balconies and a fin, an angled blade sign lined with bulbs, a rooftop terrace with festoons, a single-storey gallery annex; window ledge with stools, crate table, sidewalk tables.

plot_surf_shop.notes: Surf shop: one storey with a stepped Deco false front, fins and a giant surfboard sign outlined in bulbs on the roof; display windows wrapping the rounded corner, a side hatch ledge with stools, porch boardwalk with a bench, board rack and outdoor shower in the yard.

plot_trailer.notes: Rounded aluminium trailer under palms: polished bullet-ended trailer with a striped awning, timber deck with a picnic table, folding table in the yard, fire bowl, a pastel stucco cabana, a round camp sign lit with bulbs and festoons strung between timber poles.

tower_1.notes: 21-storey white condo slab with continuous balconies; window pattern via the tower atlas.

tower_2.notes: 30-storey coral stepped tower: solid chamfered corner piers, coral spandrels, white fins, spire.

tower_3.notes: 17-storey rounded tower: ribbon glass between white bands, powder-blue band every fourth floor, neon crown.

conventions.units: metres, glTF Y-up; plots are 20 x 16 m centred on the origin, front (terrace) toward +Z; other buildings sit on their base centre
conventions.spots: spot_0..spot_5: local +Z is the facing direction; extras.spot_kind, seat_h and table_h are heights above the empty; table_edge is the distance from the root to the near edge of the desk or counter along +Z
conventions.stool: stool spots sit 0.29 m up on the footrest so seat and counter keep seat_h and table_h above the root
conventions.props: prop:<id> empties: local +Z is the front of the prop (Poly Haven models face +Z); extras.prop_id repeats the id because three.js strips ":" from node names (the original name is in userData.name)
conventions.anchors: tag_anchor above the roof for the name tag; beam_anchor on the ground at the plot centre
conventions.materials: stucco base colour is the pastel tint (override per plot); interior, neon_accent and bulb are emissive and meant to be scaled by time of day (bulb: festoon bulbs, sconce and lantern glass, marquee bulbs; warm white, emissiveStrength 6; drive it with a night level and switch it off on vacant plots)
conventions.lights: light_0..light_n (2-4 per plot): the main night light sources. The empty sits at the source; extras.light_radius (metres, 2-6) is the radius of the soft pool to draw on the floor below, extras.light_color a warm hex colour, extras.floor_y the local height of that floor (terrace or deck top). No real lights are intended.
conventions.palms: palm_0..palm_n: base of a palm trunk (soil in a planter, the ground or the sand); extras.palm_height in metres (5-11). The empty yaw is a free per-palm turn. The beach bar palms stand on the sand at origin height: drop them onto the dune surface.
conventions.layout: layout.plots[i] is the building type for plot index i (row * 4 + col, row 0 nearest the beach); layout.hangout and layout.overflow name the shared beach bar and co-working types
conventions.textures: shared WebP files in textures/, EXT_texture_webp; ORM packed (R occlusion, G roughness, B metalness)
